# hookbase_event_type (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase event type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Define event types for outbound webhooks
resource "hookbase_event_type" "order_created" {
  name             = "order.created"
  display_name     = "Order Created"
  description      = "Fired when a new order is placed"
  category         = "orders"
  default_priority = 2  # Normal
  schema           = file("${path.module}/schemas/order-created.json")
  example_payload  = file("${path.module}/schemas/order-created-example.json")
}

resource "hookbase_event_type" "order_failed" {
  name             = "order.failed"
  display_name     = "Order Failed"
  description      = "Fired when an order processing fails"
  category         = "orders"
  default_priority = 0  # Critical
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Event type name (e.g. order.created). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `category` (String) Event type category for grouping.
- `default_priority` (Number) Default delivery priority (0=Critical, 1=High, 2=Normal, 3=Low, 4=Bulk).
- `deprecated_message` (String) Deprecation message shown to consumers.
- `description` (String) Event type description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name. Auto-generated from name if omitted.
- `documentation_url` (String) URL to external documentation.
- `example_payload` (String) Example payload as JSON string.
- `is_deprecated` (Boolean) Whether the event type is deprecated.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the event type is enabled.
- `schema` (String) JSON Schema for payload validation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Event type ID.
- `schema_version` (Number) Auto-incremented schema version.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
